posts.name: Forge Budget
posts.tagline: Simple budgeting that puts you back in control
posts.description: Forge Budget is a simple, affordable budgeting app built to help everyday people take control of their money without complicated spreadsheets or financial jargon. Quickly plan income and expenses, understand where your money is going, and build a realistic monthly budget from your phone. Built by Forge Technologies in South Africa, Forge Budget focuses on simplicity, accessibility and giving users a clear picture of their finances.

posts.name: HeadTidy
posts.tagline: Mind mapping where ideas become tasks, habits and plans
posts.description: HeadTidy is a personal visual mind-mapping workspace built for what happens after the brainstorm. Keep notes, tasks, dates, habits and checklists attached to the thoughts they belong to. Add working tables, charts, timers and decision tools or start from 77 reusable templates. Instead of moving ideas into separate apps, planning and follow-through stay connected to the map. Try the live editable map without an account.

posts.name: VaniQ
posts.tagline: Mac dictation that spells your code identifiers right
posts.description: Every dictation app turns useAuthSession into "use auth session". VaniQ reads the repo you're working in first, so your own identifiers beat the phonetically similar English. Hold a key, talk, let go. 190ms from key-up to text, all on the Neural Engine. No server, no telemetry, works with the Wi-Fi off. Wispr Flow sends your audio to its servers. Superwhisper and MacWhisper run locally but use general models, so they mangle the same names. Reading your repo is the difference.

posts.name: ScrollRank
posts.tagline: Turn your Reels addiction into a competition
posts.description: You already know how much you scroll. ScrollRank makes it official. It tracks your YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Reels and turns it into a rank, from Fresh Eyes to Certified Brainrot. Your mascot Baggy evolves with your habits, whether you like it or not. Add friends and see who's actually losing. Not a productivity app. Just going to tell you exactly how bad it's gotten.

posts.name: QBEACON
posts.tagline: Randomness you don't have to believe in.
posts.description: QBEACON publishes a public randomness beacon: a signed, hash-chained 4,096-bit value every ~2.5 minutes. Its certified-draw API picks winners from a future pulse, so nobody, not even us, can choose the outcome, and every draw gets a signed certificate and public verification page.

posts.name: Call4job
posts.tagline: Find Your Dream Job
posts.description: Launching Call4Job — a new job portal for India. 🚀 call4job.com is now live for both job seekers and employers. For job seekers: quick sign-up (Google/LinkedIn/Facebook), browse and apply to relevant openings. For employers: post jobs easily and reach active candidates without the clutter of bigger platforms. Built on Laravel, designed to be fast and simple — no unnecessary steps between you and the job you're after. Take a look: call4job.com

posts.name: Learnora
posts.tagline: Easily create, share and discover quality teaching resources
posts.description: Learnora helps busy educators create high-quality teaching resources in minutes, not hours. Generate lesson plans, assessments, rubrics, worksheets, activities and more using 30+ teacher-focused tools, or browse the growing Content Library to find ready-made resources shared by other educators. Spend less time planning and formatting, and more time teaching. Try Learnora free.

posts.name: CodeViz
posts.tagline: visualize your code stack trace
posts.description: CodeViz runs your real DSA code and lets you step through execution line by line — not a fake animation. Write in Python, JS, Java, C, C++, C#, or Go. Hit Visualize and see: • Which line is running • Variables changing step by step • Arrays as bar charts • Program output as it runs Build a private question library with starter + solution code per language. Mac desktop app + web beta. Free during early access.

posts.name: Partenio
posts.tagline: Fair work balance for shared property.
posts.description: Partenio helps families, inheritance communities and co-owners manage shared property fairly. Its core feature is the work balance: members record their contributions, and Partenio compares them with agreed ownership shares to show who has contributed more or less than their share. Projects, budgets, tasks, expenses, documents and project conversations stay organised in the same place. Built for shared houses, holiday homes, land, forests, farms and other jointly owned property.

posts.name: Misto's Financial
posts.tagline: Tend your wealth like a garden. Calm, private, local-first.
posts.description: Misto's is a calm, local-first personal finance companion. Your ledger lives on your device first. Bank sync is read-only. Backups are zero-knowledge encrypted, and your data is never sold. Includes an on-device statement importer, Safe-to-Spend, and Tax Vault.

posts.name: HallPass

posts.description: NotchIsland transforms your MacBook's notch into a live dashboard. Music, weather, timers, clipboard, drag-and-drop shelf, and more — in one shallow band that never covers your work. $6.99 one-time, no subscription.
